machinelearning.name: Machine Learning: Algorithms That Learn
machinelearning.truth: Learning is optimization in a landscape you can't fully see.
machinelearning.qfep_connection: ML systems navigate F↔E by descending loss landscapes. Gradient descent IS the oscillation between order (model) and entropy (data). Overfitting is F-collapse; underfitting is E-dominance.
machinelearning.description: From evolving creatures to neural networks — algorithms that adapt. Three arcs: evolution (selection pressure shapes form), perception (learning to classify and compress), generation (machines that make new things).
learning_objectives: Neural networks as layered feature extraction
The gap between model and reality
content: ML_Evolution: Carl Sims creatures + evolving flowers — selection pressure shapes form without explicit design
ML_Gradient_Landscape: Gradient descent visualization + PCA — navigating loss surfaces, seeing high dimensions
ML_Classification: K-means clustering + SVM + random forest — different ways to draw boundaries in data
ML_Neural_Networks: Neural network visualization + architecture exploration — layers learn features
ML_Perception: Computer vision + CNNs + attention — how machines learn to see
ML_Sequence_Memory: LSTMs + transformers — learning temporal patterns and long-range dependencies
ML_Generative: GANs + VAEs — machines that generate, not just classify
ML_Synthesis: Reinforcement learning + explainable AI — agents that act, models we can question
